instruction: Create a module that combines the functionality of the multiplexer and Johnson counter. The module should have 3 select inputs and 4 data inputs. The module should use the select inputs to choose one of the 4 data inputs to be outputted on the corresponding output. Additionally, the module should have a clock input, reset input, and a 4-bit output port that cycles through the following states: 0000, 1000, 1100, 1110, 1111, 0111, 0011, 0001, and back to 0000. You are only allowed to use shift register and XOR gate to finish this task.
